response.sql: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM MediaType AS mt JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId), with_overall_avg AS (SELECT avg_unit_price, bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) OVER () AS overall_avg_rate FROM media_type_stats) SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(bytes_per_millisecond - overall_avg_rate) AS avg_rate_above_overall FROM with_overall_avg WHERE bytes_per_millisecond > overall_avg_rate;
